description: This Java class 'ProductMixReadPlatformServiceImpl' is a service implementation within the Fineract project that handles retrieval of product mix details for loan products by interacting with the database using JDBC. It includes methods to retrieve individual and all product mixes, and a private extractor class to process result sets.

classes.name: ProductMixDataExtractor
classes.description: A private static class implementing ResultSetExtractor to process JDBC ResultSet into a Map of ProductMixData objects. It conditionally loads product data depending on the presence of result set data, utilizing services to fetch associated product collections.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductMixDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed product mix data for a specific product ID, executing a SQL query and handling exceptions if no data is found.

methods.name: retrieveAllProductMixes
methods.description: Retrieves all product mixes available, executing a SQL query and returning the collection of ProductMixData.
